output_list.criticism: The transfer function does not check if the sender has enough balance before transferring tokens. This could allow a user to transfer more tokens than they have, potentially leading to loss of funds.

The transferFrom function does not check if the sender has enough balance before transferring tokens. This could allow a user to transfer more tokens than they have, potentially leading to loss of funds.

The distributeToken function does not check if the sender has enough balance before transferring tokens to the specified addresses. This could allow a user to distribute more tokens than they have, potentially leading to loss of funds.
